selection_rule: Fourier keeps the Experiment 3 start with the smaller training-contour error. Held-out times are not used to choose it.

anisotropic.reason: The validated solver advances phi_t + R(x, y) |grad phi| = 0. A normal-dependent rate R(x, y, n) is a different Hamiltonian. directional.py implements a wind-advection split and was not part of the inverse fits. No anisotropic case was run.

direct_pinn_experimental.reason: The F1 seed-0 checkpoint forecasts only its training circle and does not estimate R. Its benchmark check is the unit test, not these unseen fields.
